purpose: A separate, hash-bound direct-EO inverse-design study restricted to acceptance caps at or below 2 V, with high-transport-number negative controls and low-current operation retained.

source_model.calculation_ceiling_interpretation: Internal ceiling used to retain failed high-voltage coordinates. It is not an accepted operating voltage; all study acceptance caps are <=2 V.

energy_ledgers.native_historical_interpretation: Inherited no-ERV direct-EO ledger. Its calculated margin is retained for regression only and must not be called system saving.

voltage_decomposition.interpretation: Deterministic post-processing scenarios. They hold the solved transport, activity and current fixed and replace only electrode plus interface voltage. They are not probabilities and are not membrane ASR scenarios.

parameter_interpretation.transport_number_note: Reference t_w maps to hydration-dependent local drag; it is not a constant measured plateau value.
parameter_interpretation.diffusion_note: At fixed thickness the sampled diffusivity scale represents the D/L direction. Do not combine marginal extrema with other studies into an untested material.
parameter_interpretation.flux_note: t_w times current density is reported as a transport-intensity diagnostic because t_w and j jointly control gross EO drag flux.
parameter_interpretation.voltage_cap_note: The V53 model is current-controlled. A cap filters calculated maximum required local voltage; it is not a fixed applied terminal voltage.
